repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供交互式开发者成长路线图，涵盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等数十个技术方向，辅以最佳实践指南与面试题库，帮助开发者系统规划职业路径并提升技能。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers interactive developer roadmaps across dozens of tech domains like frontend, backend, DevOps, AI, and data science, along with best practices and interview questions to guide career growth and skill development.

repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: roadmap.sh 是一个社区驱动的开发者成长平台，提供交互式技术路线图、学习指南和最佳实践资源，覆盖前端、后端、DevOps、AI、数据科学等 30+ 技术领域，支持按初学者/进阶路径定制学习路径，助力开发者系统化职业发展。
repos.summary_en: roadmap.sh is a community-driven platform offering interactive technology roadmaps, guides, and best practices for developers. It covers 30+ domains including Frontend, Backend, DevOps, AI, and Data Science, with beginner/advanced learning paths to support structured career growth in tech.

repos.description: WonderTrader——量化研发交易一站式框架
repos.summary_zh: WonderTrader 是一个基于 C++ 核心的一站式量化交易研发框架，覆盖数据清洗、回测到实盘交易全流程。其核心优势在于提供 CTA、SEL、HFT 和 UFT（延迟低至 175 纳秒）四大交易引擎，支持 Python/C++ 混合开发，具备高效内存数据伺服、组合盘风控及 M+1+N 多账户执行架构，专为专业机构的高频低延迟交易场景设计。
repos.summary_en: WonderTrader is a C++ based one-stop quantitative trading framework covering the full lifecycle from data cleaning and backtesting to live trading. Its core strengths include four major engines (CTA, SEL, HFT, and UFT with latency as low as 175ns), Python/C++ hybrid development, efficient memory data services, portfolio risk control, and an M+1+N multi-account execution architecture tailored for professional low-latency trading.

repos.description: Technical guide to making money and investing（最全赚钱投资指南）
repos.summary_zh: 系统整理全球经典投资理财书籍资源，覆盖初阶到高阶16本必读著作，涵盖价值投资理念、资产配置方法与财富思维建设。适合希望通过持续学习实现财务自由的读者，提供可直接获取的优质投教资源。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of 16 essential personal finance and investing books from beginner to advanced levels. Covers value investing principles, asset allocation strategies, and wealth-building mindsets. Ideal for learners seeking accessible, high-quality financial education resources on the path to financial freedom.

repos.description: 这是一个基于AI的自动化交易程序，专为数字货币市场（BNB/USDT）设计。该程序旨在实现全自动化交易，通过AI算法帮助用户在数字货币市场中做出更智能的交易决策。
repos.summary_zh: GridBNB 是一个基于 Python 的企业级自动化交易程序，专为币安交易所设计，支持多币种并发网格交易。通过动态波动率分析、EWMA 混合算法和多层风险管理，实现稳定捕捉市场波动收益。提供 Docker 容器化部署、Nginx 反向代理、实时监控 Web 界面及理财功能集成，适合专业交易者进行自动化数字货币交易。
repos.summary_en: GridBNB is a Python-based enterprise-grade automated trading program designed for Binance exchange, supporting concurrent grid trading across multiple cryptocurrency pairs. It leverages dynamic volatility analysis, EWMA hybrid algorithms, and multi-layer risk management to capture market fluctuations profitably. Features include Docker deployment, Nginx proxy, real-time monitoring web UI, and integrated savings functionality for professional crypto trading automation.

repos.summary_zh: stock-open-api 是一个开源的股票数据接口库，提供从上海证券交易所和东方财富等公开数据源的股票信息查询功能，支持A股、港股、科创板、新三板及中国概念股等市场数据，适用于学习交流与量化研究场景，不可用于商业用途。
repos.summary_en: stock-open-api is an open-source library providing stock data interfaces from public sources like the Shanghai Stock Exchange and East Money, supporting queries for A-shares, Hong Kong stocks, STAR Market, New Third Board, and US-listed Chinese companies, intended for educational and research use only.

repos.summary_zh: iNeedMyMoneyBack 是一款面向个人投资者的桌面端股票监控工具，支持 A 股、港股、美股及指数的实时行情展示。用户可自定义监控列表、显示字段与刷新频率，并在价格达到目标值时接收系统通知。界面支持表格与滚动模式、全局快捷键、双击跳转行情网站，并内置自动更新组件，适合需要持续关注持仓与大盘动态的股民使用。
repos.summary_en: iNeedMyMoneyBack is a desktop stock monitoring tool for individual investors, providing real-time quotes for A-shares, HK, US stocks, and major indices. Users can customize watchlists, display fields, and refresh intervals, and receive system notifications when target prices are reached. The app supports table and scroll views, global shortcuts, double-click navigation to financial sites, and includes an auto-update component, making it ideal for tracking portfolios and market movements.
